presentacion: Welcome to The Diesel Workshop — your first step into the professional world of automotive maintenance. In this guide, you will learn to navigate a real service workshop in English: identify tools, read safety labels, apply protection standards, and communicate with your team using technical language. This is not just about learning words — it is about speaking the language of the job from day one. You will explore how a professional workshop is organized, why safety rules exist in English-speaking environments, and how to classify the types of maintenance that keep diesel vehicles on the road. By the end of this guide, you will be able to describe your workspace, select the right tools, and report safety conditions to a supervisor — all in English.

guide_design_dna.enfoque: Anclar el vocabulario técnico al entorno físico real del taller desde el primer día. El aprendiz aprende a nombrar lo que ya conoce en español y lo traslada al registro profesional en inglés.
entendimientos_perdurables: A professional mechanic communicates safety conditions clearly — in any language.
Tools have precise names in English because manufacturers, manuals, and specs are written in English.
Preventive maintenance starts with an organized, safe, and well-identified workspace.

technical_topics: Types and characteristics of automotive service workshops
Workshop areas: reception bay, service bay, storage, wash area, electrical room
Types of maintenance: preventive, corrective, predictive, scheduled
Hand tools and power tools: selection, identification, care
Measuring instruments: torque wrench, multimeter, vernier caliper, pressure gauge
Personal Protective Equipment (PPE): types, use, legal requirements
Workplace safety: hazard identification, spill response, SST norms
Environmental standards: waste disposal, fluid handling
Workshop formats: work order, service checklist, daily inspection log
communicative_functions: Identifying and naming tools, areas, and equipment

language_functions_in_context.example: This is a torque wrench. These are safety goggles.
The workshop has three service bays. Each bay has a floor jack.
This tool is for tightening. That area is for washing.
Use a wrench. The wrench is on the workbench.
The toolbox is next to the workbench. The extinguisher is behind the door.
There is a chemical spill. There are two fire extinguishers in this area.
You wear gloves. The technician checks the torque. We follow SST rules.
Put on your goggles. Check the floor jack before use. Report all spills.

key_vocabulary.context: The diesel workshop has four service bays.
Bay 2 is reserved for oil changes.
Clean the workbench after every job.
Every technician has a personal toolbox.
Use the open-end wrench for the bolt.
The ratchet speeds up the job in tight spaces.
Select the correct socket size before tightening.
Use a torque wrench to apply 120 Nm.
Never get under a vehicle without a floor jack.
PPE includes goggles, gloves, and safety boots.
Wear safety goggles when using the grinder.
Nitrile gloves protect against chemical exposure.
A spilled fluid is a slip hazard on the floor.
Report any oil spill to the supervisor immediately.
Preventive maintenance avoids unexpected breakdowns.
Corrective maintenance fixes a fault that already occurred.
Fill in the work order before starting any job.
Use the daily inspection checklist every morning.
The fire extinguisher must be accessible at all times.
All measuring tools require periodic calibration.

integrative_task.descripcion: En equipos de 3, los aprendices asumen el rol de nuevos técnicos en The Diesel Workshop. Su misión: preparar el taller para la apertura del día en inglés. Deben identificar y etiquetar en inglés todas las herramientas del toolbox, inspeccionar las condiciones de seguridad del área de trabajo, completar el daily inspection checklist, y reportar verbalmente el estado del taller a su supervisor en inglés antes de las 8:00 AM.
integrative_task.entregable_escrito: Daily Inspection Checklist completado en inglés con observaciones de seguridad
integrative_task.entregable_oral: Briefing de 60–90 segundos al supervisor describiendo el estado del taller y cualquier hazard identificado

evaluation_matrix.criterio: Identifica correctamente herramientas, tipos de mantenimiento y normas SST en inglés
Usa vocabulario técnico correcto durante el Workshop Readiness Report oral
El Daily Inspection Checklist está completo, en inglés, con observaciones pertinentes

competencia.nombre: Interactuar en Lengua Inglesa de Forma Oral y Escrita dentro de Contextos Sociales y Laborales según los Criterios Establecidos por el Marco Común Europeo de Referencia para las Lenguas

curated_sources.titulo: Essential Auto Repair Tools Every Mechanic Needs

curated_sources.resumen: Recorre las herramientas esenciales de cualquier mecánico de taller — desde llaves y ratchets hasta torquímetros — con fotos, usos y recomendaciones. Explica por qué cada herramienta es crítica y cuándo se usa. Tono accesible y motivacional para técnicos jóvenes.
